metadata.title: SpaceX Stock Will Be ‘Worth More Than the Rest of Earth,’ Musk Says. How He Gets There.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
SpaceX Will Be ‘Worth More Than the Rest of Earth,’ Musk Says. How He Gets There.
This has been valuation week for SpaceX, with more than a dozen analysts writing initial research following the company’s record-setting June IPO. And Elon Musk’s blows all of their targets out of the water.
